scope: Obtain the remaining p4_m2 moment by swapping X,Y in the checked p2_m4 result, reusing the existing quadratic involution.
existing_results: Mathlib QuadraticAlgebra.lift supplies the algebra morphism; side_conjugates and moment_conjugates supply the conjugation relation; use original quadSide and original Newton formulas.
search_limit: Direct named/textual swap searches found no compatible adapter in the complete corpus. This is not a claim about unpublished work or all equivalent formulations.
new_work: Only the necessary parameter/root scaling adapter; no competing p4_m2 normalization or new moment arrays.

table_binding.approach: Compare each existing k coefficient in the two existing dense tables using ring in X,Y only; existing list_eq_of_getD and eval_scale assemble the result. No arrays generated.
